verdict: Meta is delivering leads efficiently; Google spend needs to earn its place.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, you received 118 leads entirely through Meta at a blended cost of $25.60 per lead — and over the most recent 7 days, that cost dropped 44% while lead volume grew 33%, a genuine efficiency gain. At the same time, Google Ads consumed $1,950 over the same 28-day window with zero recorded conversions; that spend has been pulled back while we work to get proper conversion tracking in place for that channel. Your Google Business Profile drove 36 direction requests this period, but is recording no calls and no website clicks — a phone call-to-action is being added to close that gap. The priority between now and month-end is confirming that leads arriving through Meta are moving through your intake pipeline and converting, which requires completing the CRM and payment path builds currently in progress.

highlights.phrase: leads received this period, all from Meta
cost per lead this period, down 44% week over week
spent on Google Ads this period with no conversions recorded

watch_item.issue: Google Ads is spending with no conversions recorded — the channel is not paying its way.
watch_item.fix: Spend has been reduced while offline conversion tracking is being connected; Google will not receive full budget until it demonstrates measurable return.
